description: Returns a URL to the Cuecaps studio, opened set up exactly as the user described (style, font, colors, how the spoken word stands out, animation, size, format and language), for the user to finish in their browser: they drop in the video, can fix words and export there. With fast, the studio also turns on Fast edit as soon as the words are found, so "cut my pauses and caption this" is one link. Creates nothing and needs no key, so it works on every plan, Free included; exporting with Fast edit comes with Creator and Pro. Use it when the user wants to edit by hand, has no Creator or Pro key, or the file isn't on this machine; use caption_video to make the file directly.

anim.description: How each caption comes in: pop, punch (slams down from large), bounce, rise, slide, fade, focus (from a blur), typewriter (letter by letter) or none.

aspect.description: Frame shape: 9:16 for TikTok, Shorts and Reels, 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts, 16:9 for YouTube.

case.description: Letter case: upper for capitals, lower, or as-spoken.

color.description: Text color: a hex value such as #FFFFFF, or white, black, yellow, gold, orange, red, pink, purple, blue, cyan, green, lime.

emphasis.description: Color of the key words the studio picks for emphasis, as a hex value or a color name.

fast.description: Fast edit tools to turn on once the words are found: deadspace cuts the pauses, fillers cuts um, uh and stutters, retakes keeps the last take of a restarted sentence, zoom punches in on the jump cuts, norm levels the volume to -14 LUFS. all turns on every one. Captions, subtitles and overlays follow the cut.

font.description: Caption font, in place of the style's own.

highlight.description: Color of the word being spoken, as a hex value or a color name. A style that doesn't color the spoken word starts to.

lang.description: The spoken language. Give it for any video that isn't in English; auto lets cloud transcription detect it.

mark.description: How the spoken word stands out: color it, a box behind it, grow it, dim the words not yet spoken, reveal words as they are spoken, or none.

position.description: Where the captions sit in the frame.

size.description: Caption size as a percent of the style's own: 125 for bigger, 80 for smaller.

style.description: Caption style. list_styles shows how each one looks.

voice.description: true removes background noise, music and room sound from the voice once the words are found (Clean up voice, a Fast edit tool; Chrome or Edge on a computer, after a one-time 130 MB download).

words.description: Words per caption; 1 shows one word at a time.

name: studio_link
